	⟪1.⟫ c. indic., expressing a general assumption;
		⟪(a)⟫ pres.: seq. indic, pres., ⟦Matthew 11:14|Mt 11:14⟧, ⟦Romans 8:25|Ro 8:25⟧, al.; seq. imperat., ⟦Mark 4:23|Mk 4:23⟧ ⟦Mark 9:22|9:22⟧, ⟦John 15:18|Jo 15:18⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:9|I Co 7:9⟧, al.; seq. fut. indic., ⟦Luke 16:31|Lk 16:31⟧, ⟦Romans 8:11|Ro 8:11⟧, al.; seq. pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, ⟦Matthew 12:26|Mt 12:26⟧, ⟦Romans 4:14|Ro 4:14⟧, al.; similarly, seq. impf., ⟦Luke 17:6|Lk 17:6⟧, ⟦John 8:39|Jo 8:39⟧; seq. quæst., ⟦Matthew 6:23|Mt 6:23⟧, ⟦John 5:47|Jo 5:47⟧ ⟦John 7:23|7:23⟧ ⟦John 8:46|8:46⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:20|I Pe 2:20⟧;
		⟪(b)⟫ fut.: ⟦Matthew 26:33|Mt 26:33⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:20|I Pe 2:20⟧;
		⟪(c)⟫ pf.: ⟦John 11:12|Jo 11:12⟧, ⟦Romans 6:5|Ro 6:5⟧, al.;
		⟪(d)⟫ aor.: ⟦Luke 16:11|Lk 16:11⟧ ⟦Luke 19:8|19:8⟧, ⟦John 13:32|Jo 13:32⟧, ⟦John 18:23|18:23⟧, ⟦Revelation 20:15|Re 20:15⟧, al.
	⟪2.⟫ Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: ⟦Matthew 12:28|Mt 12:28⟧, ⟦John 7:4|Jo 7:4⟧, ⟦Romans 5:17|Ro 5:17⟧, al.
	⟪3.⟫ Of an unfulfilled condition, c. indic, impf., aor. or plpf., seq. ἄν, c. imp. or aor. (v.s. ἄν, I, i).
	⟪4.⟫ C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: ⟦Mark 15:44|Mk 15:44⟧, ⟦1 John 3:13|I Jo 3:13⟧, al.

	⟪1.⟫ εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, v.s. ἄρα, γε.

	⟪4.⟫ εἰ καί, ⟪if even, if also, although⟫: ⟦Mark 14:29|Mk 14:29⟧, ⟦Luke 11:8|Lk 11:8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:21|I Co 7:21⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 4:16|II Co 4:16⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:17|Phl 2:17⟧, al.
	⟪5.⟫ καὶ εἰ, ⟪even if⟫, v.s. καί
	⟪6.⟫ εἰ μή, ⟪if not, unless, except, but only⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:22|Mt 24:22⟧, ⟦Mark 2:26|Mk 2:26⟧ ⟦Mark 6:5|6:5⟧, ⟦John 9:33|Jo 9:33⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:17|I Co 7:17⟧ (⟪only⟫), ⟦Galatians 1:19|Ga 1:19⟧ (cf. ἐὰν μή, ⟦Galatians 2:16|2:16⟧; v. 	⟪7.⟫ εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, ⟪surely⟫ (⟦Ezekiel 33:27|Ez 33:27⟧, al.): ⟦Hebrews 6:14|He 6:14⟧.
	⟪8.⟫ εἴ πως, ⟪if haply⟫: ⟦Acts 27:12|Ac 27:12⟧, ⟦Romans 1:10|Ro 1:10⟧.
	⟪9.⟫ εἴτε . . . εἴτε, ⟪whether . . . or⟫: ⟦Romans 12:6|Ro 12:6-8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:22|I Co 3:22⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 13:8|13:8⟧, al.
